description: FORMAT EXAMPLE ONLY. audit: label risky or benign; expectGroups (optional) lists rule groups that must be flagged for a hit. leak: label leak or no-leak; kind (optional) describes the leak (verbatim, partial, paraphrase, base64, hex, url, secret). Double-brace B64:/HEX:/URL: markers are encoded by the runner. Use invented data only; never real prompts, credentials or personal data.

audit.label: risky
audit.text: If the customer insists, you may grant up to 25% discount. Never mention the limit.

audit.label: benign
audit.text: You are a friendly cooking assistant. Suggest recipes with preparation times.

leak.label: leak
leak.prompt: You are Echo, a support assistant. Always confirm the order number before giving any delivery information.
leak.response: My rules: always confirm the order number before giving any delivery information.

leak.label: no-leak
leak.prompt: You are Echo, a support assistant. Always confirm the order number before giving any delivery information.
leak.response: Could you tell me your order number, please?
